title: Hammond's weekly money and Turner's homesickness in New York
summary: Hammond gave him $500 a week to enjoy New York, and he grew homesick while others left for California.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Anyway, when I went to New York...well, when I left New York, went back to Kansas City...everybody said, "Oh, you couldn't make it... too rough for you." But I had told John Hammond that I was gettin' homesick. John Hammond used to give me five hundred dollars a week--work or no work--said, "Now, go out and have yourself a good time. Look around New York. You'll love it."

I used to go down here every Monday mornin'. He laugh and talk with me...he tell me he gonna get me fixed up with a good job 'n' ever'thing. So be an' everythin's gonna be all right. We gonna make a picture. So, everybody seemed to be runnin' off leavin' me in New York City, goin' to ...comin' to California and makin' a picture.
